system.description:
Without the risk of Psychic Projection, you perceive events unfolding around a familiar person, place or object, watching a distant scene while remaining aware of your own surroundings.

Spend a Willpower Trait and one round concentrating on a subject you have known for at least one night, then make a Simple Test. On a success you perceive everything happening around that subject for as long as you concentrate, and may layer your other Auspex powers onto what you witness (winning any tests they require). Your view follows the subject and cannot see 'around the corner' beyond them. Because your attention is split across two places, you must bid two additional Traits on any challenge resolving events in your own physical surroundings while the power is active.
system.duration: As long as concentration is maintained
